integrity: The theorem is supported by an analytic proof. The accompanying finite exact-rational tests are checks and not infinite-dimensional certifications.
scientific_limitations: Proved for nonzero constant scalar weights and invertible diagonal linear symbols on H(C^d), finite d. Does not address Jordan blocks, nonlinear symbols, nonconstant weights or noninvertible symbols. Publication priority is assessed by best-knowledge literature comparisons, not independently certified.
title: Exact shadowing criterion for diagonal weighted compositions on entire-function spaces
